messages:
maria-g: incident-bot just fired: pd: latency.p90 > 1200ms across eu-west-1 routers — auto page
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC4440001234 triggered by alert-rule latency.p90-eu-west1 (threshold 1200ms). Notifying: @maria-g, @ajay
maria-g: acking, looking
ajay: acked, joining — grabbing metrics, can someone post the dashboard link?
leo: dash: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/ingress-latency?panelId=2
maria-g: seeing a 3–4 minute spike then back down, looks like noisy upstream load. No error rates.
ajay: running `kubectl get pods -n ingress -o wide | grep router` now
leo: router pods show CPU spikes on a subset (node pool gp2-eu) — maybe autoscale lag
maria-g: quick check: customer-facing errors? logs show 200s still. Spotty 503s? only 0.01% — almost none.
incident-bot: Incident marked as 'acknowledged' by maria-g at 2026-03-15T10:11:05Z
ajay: trying a temporary route bounce for the two noisy pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/router-eu --namespace=ingress --selector=az=euc1b`
leo: rolling, should be quick
maria-g: FYI putting this on 'no-customer-impact' for now but will keep open for 10m
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC4440001234 auto-resolved by alert suppression at 2026-03-15T10:14:30Z (duration 3m16s)
ajay: looks like restart helped, p90 back to normal
maria-g: agree, no ongoing trends. we'll let PG keep watch
leo: will file a short follow-up to check node autoscale thresholds in eng-infra
maria-g: thanks — closing thread in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:
oncall-shiftbot: Note: handoff to night oncall @leo in 2 hours
maria-g: adding a one-line postmortem to incidents channel in case we need it
ajay: thx — good catch on the subset pattern, might be a noisy hostclass
leo: copying metrics to a small alert ticket to tweak suppression window
maria-g: closing here — re-open if it recurs.
